title: Assessing AI-Generated vs. Human-Authored Spear Phishing SMS Attacks: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2406.13049v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Personalized phishing is difficult to defend against because messages can be tailored to a target's work, interests, and social context. Large language models may make such tailoring faster and easier, but it remains unclear whether messages produced from simple prompts are more convincing than those written by people. This 25-target pilot study compared personalized smishing messages generated by GPT-4 with messages written by novice student authors working under time constraints. Using the proposed Threshold Ranking Approach for Personalized Deception (TRAPD), participants ranked 12 messages written for them, indicated the point at which they would intend to click, explained their reasoning, and judged whether each message was authored by GPT-4 or a human. translated_title: 评估AI生成与人类编写的定向钓鱼短信攻击：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2406.13049v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：个性化钓鱼攻击难以防御，因为消息可以根据目标的工作、兴趣和社会背景进行定制。大型语言模型可能使这种定制更快更容易，但仍不清楚由简单提示生成的消息是否比人类编写的消息更具说服力。这项针对25个目标的试点研究比较了由GPT-4生成的个性化短信钓鱼消息与在时间限制下工作的新手学生作者编写的消息。使用提出的阈值排名方法进行个性化欺骗（TRAPD），参与者对为其编写的12条消息进行排名，指出他们意图点击的临界点，解释他们的推理，并判断每条消息是由GPT-4还是人类编写的。GPT-4生成的消息比学生编写的消息更频繁地引发点击意图（28%对比21%），尽管这种差异存在不确定性。更广泛地说，我们的研究...
tldr: 本研究通过25个目标的试点实验，首次实证比较了GPT-4生成与人类编写的定向钓鱼短信，发现AI生成的消息在引发点击意图上略高（28%对21%），并提出了新的TRAPD评估方法。
en_tdlr: This pilot study with 25 targets empirically compares GPT-4-generated and human-authored spear phishing SMS, finding AI messages elicit slightly higher click intention (28% vs 21%) and introducing the TRAPD evaluation method.
